dedupe_keys.name: telcor nicaragua telecommunications service coverage maps mobile fixed internet fibre broadcast

description: TELCOR, Nicaragua's telecommunications and postal regulator, publishes coverage maps of telecommunication services. The main page, updated in January 2024, gives interactive mobile coverage maps for Claro, Tigo and Cootel, showing received signal levels for 2G, 3G and 4G, hosted on the Felt mapping platform, with national and department-level views. Further pages cover fixed telephony, internet access, the fibre optic network, cable television, national television channels, and national AM and FM radio. Coverage: Nicaragua, national with department detail. Format and access: interactive web maps and images on the TELCOR site and on Felt, free; no licence is stated and no download of the underlying layers was offered on the pages read. Caveats: operator-declared or regulator-measured signal levels are not described in detail; the maps are a snapshot, not a series; Felt may allow layer export only to the map owner. Simulation uses: service areas by technology and operator for exposure of mobile networks to hurricanes, floods and volcanic hazards, and for coverage gaps in resilience studies. Related records: data-central-america-3g-coverage-by-municipality gives 3G coverage by municipality for Nicaragua; data-opencellid gives crowdsourced cell locations.
